key.description: One policy leaf: retention.<kind>, sensitivity.<kind>, thresholds.<name>, scripts.<timeout_seconds|log_bytes|output_files|output_file_bytes>, packs, models.careful, demo.simulated_until, open_weights.<endpoint|model|kind|label>, or the whole open_weights block. Secrets, other whole mappings and open_weights.capabilities/verified_at (written only by office.private-route-check) are refused. Calendar leaves: calendar.connection, calendar.window_days_past, calendar.window_days_ahead, calendar.prep_lead_minutes, calendar.prep_max_per_run. shared (a complete remote, branch, member block, or null) and shared.remote/branch/member are settable. Scribe: scribe.cadence, scribe.tags and scribe.tags.<name>. Also scribe.precedents.half_life_days. Meetings: meetings.agent_workspace.

value.description: Typed JSON value, validated for the selected key. Retention is 1–36500 days or null; sensitivity is normal/private; packs is a distinct list of meetings/receipts; thresholds are bounded positive integers; scripts bounds are positive integers up to timeout_seconds=1800, log_bytes=1048576, output_files=8, output_file_bytes=1048576; open_weights is a mapping of endpoint (an HTTPS base URL, or HTTP(S) on loopback; never api.meta.ai), model, kind (company, provider or own_hardware) and label, or null. demo.simulated_until is a YYYY-MM-DD date, or null to clear it. Changing the endpoint or model clears the recorded capabilities. models.careful is a nonempty ASCII model slug of at most 128 bytes (letters, digits, -._/:); the default is muse-wonder. Calendar: connection is 1–48 ASCII letters, digits, _ or - (null clears it); window_days_past/ahead are 1–90; prep_lead_minutes 15–1440; prep_max_per_run 1–20. shared.remote accepts ssh://, scp-style, HTTPS without user information or an absolute repository path; shared.member is lowercase kebab-case, 1–32 characters. Credential-bearing and unsupported remotes are refused without echoing the value. scribe.cadence is a mapping of minutes (5–240, default 20) and turns (2–100, default 10), or null for the defaults; scribe.tags is the whole list of tag definitions, or null to restore the two defaults (preferences, decisions); scribe.tags.<name> is one definition or null to delete it. A definition is {name, scope (global|project|session), instruction, sink (decisions_ledger|preference_page|scr_only|orbit_task), mode (propose|apply|append), capture (markers|markers+inferred), workspace}; name is lowercase kebab-case (1–32 characters) and unique; sink and mode pair as preference_page with propose or apply, orbit_task with propose, and decisions_ledger or scr_only with append; workspace is accepted only on orbit_task and must be a selector, not a path. A definition naming a file target is refused with tag_sink_refused. scribe.precedents.half_life_days is an integer from 1 to 3650 (default 90); null restores 90. meetings.agent_workspace is an Orbit workspace selector (nonempty, at most 256 bytes, letters, digits and -._/:) that receives agent-owned code to-dos from meeting extraction, or null to keep every meeting to-do owner:you.
